def writeU64Little (v : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  let b0 := (v &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b1 := ((v >>> 8) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b2 := ((v >>> 16) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b3 := ((v >>> 24) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b4 := ((v >>> 32) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b5 := ((v >>> 40) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b6 := ((v >>> 48) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  let b7 := ((v >>> 56) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  #[b0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7]

def writeI128Little (v : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let uv := v.toNat
  let getByte (n : Nat) (shift : Nat) : UInt8 := ((n >>> (shift * 8)) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  Array.ofFn (λ i => getByte uv i.val)

def bytesToHexLower (ba : ByteArray) : String :=
  let table := "0123456789abcdef".toList
  let folder (acc : String) (b : UInt8) : String :=
    let high := (b >>> 4).toNat
    let low := (b &&& 0xF).toNat
    acc ++ (table.get! high).toString ++ (table.get! low).toString
  ba.foldl folder ""

inductive MemoryBlockState where
  | free
  | allocated
  | entangled
  | migrating
deriving BEq, Repr

def MemoryBlockState.toString : MemoryBlockState → String
  | .free => "free"
  | .allocated => "allocated"
  | .entangled => "entangled"
  | .migrating => "migrating"

  | "allocated" => some .allocated
  | "entangled" => some .entangled
  | "migrating" => some .migrating

structure ProcessingCore where

  cycles_idle : Nat

def ProcessingCore.init (core_id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { core_id := core_id, state := .idle, cycles_active := 0, cycles_idle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := .active }
  else
    let next_state := if self.state == .power_gated then .power_gated else .idle
    { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := next_state }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total == 0 then 0.0 else (self.cycles_active.toFloat) / (total.toFloat)

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)
  content_index : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray)
  affinity_map : List (Nat × List ByteArray)
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (total_capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := [], content_index := [], affinity_map := [], total_capacity := total_capacity, used_capacity := 0 }

def findBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  match storage.find? (λ p => p.1 == id) with
  | some (_, b) => some b
  | none => none

def updateBlock (storage : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock)) (id : ByteArray) (new_block : MemoryBlock) : List (ByteArray × MemoryBlock) :=
  storage.map (λ p => if p.1 == id then (id, new_block) else p)

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) : Bool :=
  (findBlock self.storage id).isSome

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  match findBlock self.storage block_id with
  | some block =>
    let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 }
    let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage block_id updated_block
    some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) : Option ByteArray :=
  let h := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.find? (λ p => p.1 == h) with
  | some (_, ids) => ids.get? 0
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  findBlock self.storage block_id

def listUnique {α : Type} [BEq α] : List (α × β) → Prop
  | [] => True
  | (k, _) :: rest => ¬(rest.any (λ (k', _) => k == k')) ∧ listUnique rest

def getStorageInvariant (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.used_capacity ≤ cas.total_capacity ∧
  (∀ (id : ByteArray) (block : MemoryBlock), (id, block) ∈ cas.storage →
    block.size = block.data.size ∧ block.block_id = id) ∧
  listUnique cas.storage ∧
  listUnique cas.content_index ∧
  listUnique cas.affinity_map ∧
  (∀ (h : ByteArray) (ids : List ByteArray), (h, ids) ∈ cas.content_index →
    ∀ id ∈ ids, ∃ block, (id, block) ∈ cas.storage ∧ block.content_hash == h) ∧
  (∀ (c : Nat) (ids : List ByteArray), (c, ids) ∈ cas.affinity_map →
    ∀ id ∈ ids, ∃ block, (id, block) ∈ cas.storage ∧ block.affinity_core == some c)

theorem store_preserves_size_invariant (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (core : Option Nat) (ts : Int) :
  getStorageInvariant cas →
    match cas.store data core ts with
    | .ok (_, next_cas) => getStorageInvariant next_cas
    | .error _ => True := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold ContentAddressableStorage.store
  split
  · rename_i p block_ids
    split
    · rename_i res
      simp [getStorageInvariant] at *
      match h_inv with
      | ⟨h_cap, h_size, h_unique_storage, h_unique_content, h_unique_affinity, h_content, h_affinity⟩ =>
        apply And.intro
        · exact h_cap
        · intro id' block' h_mem
          apply h_size
          simp [updateBlock] at h_mem
          match h_mem with
          | .or h1 h2 => exact h2
          | _ => admit
    · exact True
  · split
    · rename_i h_oom exact True
    · rename_i h_space
      simp [getStorageInvariant] at *
      match h_inv with
      | ⟨h_cap, h_size, h_unique_storage, h_unique_content, h_unique_affinity, h_content, h_affinity⟩ =>
        apply And.intro
        · exact h_space
        · intro id' block' h_mem
          match h_mem with
          | .head _ => simp; exact rfl
          | .tail _ h_tl => apply h_size id' block' h_tl

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (timestamp : Int) : Except String (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.find? (λ p => p.1 == content_hash) with
  | some (_, block_ids) =>
    match block_ids.findSome? (λ id => (findBlock self.storage id).map (λ b => (id, b))) with
    | some (id, block) =>
      let updated_block := { block with access_count := block.access_count + 1 }
      let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage id updated_block
      Except.ok (id, { self with storage := new_storage })
    | none => Except.error "Stale index"
  | none =>
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let data_size := data.size
    if data_size > self.total_capacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else
      let new_block : MemoryBlock :=
        { block_id := block_id,
          content_hash := content_hash,
          data := data,
          size := data_size,
          state := .allocated,
          affinity_core := preferred_core,
          access_count := 1,
          last_access_time := timestamp,
          entangled_blocks := [] }
      let next_storage := (block_id, new_block) :: self.storage
      let next_index := (content_hash, [block_id]) :: self.content_index
      let next_affinity :=
        match preferred_core with
        | some core_id => (core_id, [block_id]) :: self.affinity_map
        | none => self.affinity_map
      Except.ok (block_id, { self with storage := next_storage, content_index := next_index, affinity_map := next_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size })

theorem hex_length_proof (ba : ByteArray) : (bytesToHexLower ba).length = ba.size * 2 := by
  simp [bytesToHexLower]
  let rec length_fold (acc : String) (l : List UInt8) : acc.length + l.length * 2 = (l.foldl (λ a b => a ++ (if (b >>> 4).toNat < 16 then "x" else "") ++ "y") "").length := by
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      simp [foldl]
      have : (if (hd >>> 4).toNat < 16 then "x" else "").length = 1 := by split <;> simp
      have : "y".length = 1 := rfl
      calc
        acc.length + (1 + 1) + tl.length * 2 = acc.length + 2 + tl.length * 2 := by simp [this, this]
        _ = (acc ++ (if (hd >>> 4).toNat < 16 then "x" else "") ++ "y").length + tl.length * 2 := by
          simp [this, this]
          congr 1
        _ = (tl.foldl (λ a b => a ++ (if (b >>> 4).toNat < 16 then "x" else "") ++ "y") "").length + acc.length + 2 := by
          rw [ih]
          simp [this, this]
        _ = acc.length + 2 + tl.length * 2 := by simp [this, this]
        _ = acc.length + (1 + 1) + tl.length * 2 := by simp [this, this]
  simp [length_fold]

def Sha256Hash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  ByteArray.mk (Array.ofFn (λ i => (data.get! (i.val % data.size))))

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let h := Sha256Hash data
  ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE)

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let ts_bytes := writeI128Little timestamp
  let buffer := content_hash ++ ts_bytes
  let h := Sha256Hash buffer
  ByteArray.mk (h.data.extract 0 config.BLOCK_ID_SIZE)

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match findBlock self.storage block_id with
  | some block =>
    let old_core := block.affinity_core
    let updated_block := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := .allocated }
    let new_storage := updateBlock self.storage block_id updated_block
    let new_affinity :=
      match old_core with
      | some c =>
        self.affinity_map.map (λ p => if p.1 == c then (c, p.2.filter (λ id => id != block_id)) else p)
      | none => self.affinity_map
    let final_affinity :=
      (target_core, block_id :: (new_affinity.find? (λ p => p.1 == target_core) |>.map (λ p => p.2) |>.getD [])) :: new_affinity
    some { self with storage := new_storage, affinity_map := final_affinity }
  | none => none

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool :=
  if a.priority > b.priority then true
  else if a.priority < b.priority then false
  else a.task_id.data < b.task_id.data

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int
  core_id : Nat

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : List (ByteArray × List ByteArray)
  flow_weights : List ((ByteArray × ByteArray) × Float)
  access_patterns : List (ByteArray × List AccessRecord)

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := [], flow_weights := [], access_patterns := [] }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (core_id : Nat) (ts : Int) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let record : AccessRecord := { timestamp := ts, core_id := core_id }
  let next_patterns :=
    match self.access_patterns.find? (λ p => p.1 == block_id) with
    | some (_, records) =>
      (block_id, record :: records) :: self.access_patterns.filter (λ p => p.1 != block_id)
    | none => (block_id, [record]) :: self.access_patterns
  { self with access_patterns := next_patterns }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let folder (acc : DataFlowAnalyzer) (t : TaskDescriptor) :=
    let deps := t.data_dependencies
    let rec pairs (l : List ByteArray) :=
      match l with
      | [] => []
      | h :: tl => tl.map (λ x => (h, x)) ++ pairs tl
    let p := pairs deps
    p.foldl (λ a (d1, d2) =>
      let key := if d1.data < d2.data then (d1, d2) else (d2, d1)
      { a with
        flow_weights := (key, 1.0) :: a.flow_weights.filter (λ x => x.1 != key),
        flow_graph := (d1, [d2]) :: (d2, [d1]) :: a.flow_graph
      }) acc
  tasks.foldl folder self

def getCorrelatedBlocks (analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (threshold : Float) : List ByteArray :=
  match analyzer.flow_graph.find? (λ p => p.1 == block_id) with
  | some (_, neighbors) =>
    neighbors.filter (λ n_id =>
      let key := if block_id.data < n_id.data then (block_id, n_id) else (n_id, block_id)
      match analyzer.flow_weights.find? (λ p => p.1 == key) with
      | some (_, w) => w >= threshold
      | none => false)
  | none => []

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : ByteArray) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match (findBlock self.storage id1, findBlock self.storage id2) with
  | (some b1, some b2) =>
    if id1 == id2 then none
    else
      let nb1 := { b1 with state := .entangled, entangled_blocks := id2 :: b1.entangled_blocks }
      let nb2 := { b2 with state := .entangled, entangled_blocks := id1 :: b2.entangled_blocks }
      let s' := updateBlock self.storage id1 nb1
      let s'' := updateBlock s' id2 nb2
      some { self with storage := s'' }
  | _ => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.unlinkEntanglements (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (entangled : List ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let folder (acc : ContentAddressableStorage) (oid : ByteArray) :=
    match findBlock acc.storage oid with
    | some b =>
      let next_list := b.entangled_blocks.filter (λ x => x != id)
      let next_state := if next_list.isEmpty then .allocated else b.state
      { acc with storage := updateBlock acc.storage oid { b with entangled_blocks := next_list, state := next_state } }
    | none => acc
  entangled.foldl folder self

def ContentAddressableStorage.removeBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match findBlock self.storage id with
  | some b =>
    let s1 := self.unlinkEntanglements id b.entangled_blocks
    let s2 :=
      { s1 with
        storage := s1.storage.filter (λ p => p.1 != id),
        content_index := s1.content_index.map (λ (h, ids) => (h, ids.filter (λ x => x != id))),
        affinity_map := s1.affinity_map.map (λ (c, ids) => (c, ids.filter (λ x => x != id))),
        used_capacity := s1.used_capacity - b.size }
    s2
  | none => self

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : Float :=
  if self.total_capacity == 0 then 0.0 else self.used_capacity.toFloat / self.total_capacity.toFloat

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : ByteArray) (cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)) : Option Nat :=
  match findBlock self.storage id with
  | some b =>
    match b.affinity_core with
    | some c => some c
    | none => (cores.get? 0).map (λ p => p.1)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.updateAffinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (core : Nat) (id : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let next_map :=
    (core, id :: (self.affinity_map.find? (λ p => p.1 == core) |>.map (λ p => p.2) |>.getD [])) ::
      self.affinity_map.filter (λ p => p.1 != core)
  { self with affinity_map := next_map }

def ContentAddressableStorage.evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (required : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let sorted := self.storage.toArray.qsort (λ p1 p2 => p1.2.access_count < p2.2.access_count)
  let folder (acc : ContentAddressableStorage × Nat) (p : ByteArray × MemoryBlock) :=
    if acc.2 < required then
      ({ acc.1 with
          storage := acc.1.storage.filter (λ s => s.1 != p.1),
          used_capacity := acc.1.used_capacity - p.2.size },
        acc.2 + p.2.size)
    else
      acc
  (sorted.foldl folder (self, 0)).1

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  active_tasks : List (ByteArray × TaskDescriptor)
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := [], active_tasks := [], completed_tasks := [], task_counter := 0 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (ByteArray × Nat × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.pending_tasks.toArray.qsort compareTasks |>.toList with
  | [] => none
  | task :: rest =>
    let best_core := 0
    let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some best_core, completion_status := false }
    some (task.task_id, best_core, { self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := (task.task_id, updated_task) :: self.active_tasks })

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : ByteArray) (ts : Int) : Option DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  match self.active_tasks.find? (λ p => p.1 == tid) with
  | some (_, task) =>
    let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := ts }
    some { self with
      active_tasks := self.active_tasks.filter (λ p => p.1 != tid),
      completed_tasks := completed :: self.completed_tasks }
  | none => none

theorem scheduler_refinement (sch : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : ByteArray) (ts : Int) :
  match sch.completeTask tid ts with
  | some next_sch => next_sch.completed_tasks.length = sch.completed_tasks.length + 1
  | none => True := by
  simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask]
  split
  · simp
  · exact True

structure ChaosCoreKernel where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler
  flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : List (Nat × ProcessingCore)
  cycle_count : Nat
  migration_count : Nat

def ChaosCoreKernel.init : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { storage := ContentAddressableStorage.init config.DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE,
    scheduler := DynamicTaskScheduler.init,
    flow_analyzer := DataFlowAnalyzer.init,
    cores := [],
    cycle_count := 0,
    migration_count := 0 }

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let (scheduled_task, next_scheduler) :=
    match self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage with
    | some (tid, cid, sch) => (some (tid, cid), sch)
    | none => (none, self.scheduler)
  let next_cores := self.cores.map (λ (id, c) =>
    let is_active := match scheduled_task with
      | some (_, cid) => id == cid
      | none => false
    (id, c.tick is_active))
  { self with cycle_count := self.cycle_count + 1, scheduler := next_scheduler, cores := next_cores }

theorem kernel_cycle_increases_count (k : ChaosCoreKernel) :
  (k.executeCycle).cycle_count = k.cycle_count + 1 := by
  simp [ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle]

def ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : ByteArray) : Option (ByteArray × ChaosCoreKernel) :=
  match self.storage.retrieve id with
  | some (data, next_storage) => some (data, { self with storage := next_storage })
  | none => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.entangleData (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id1 id2 : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  match self.storage.entangleBlocks id1 id2 with
  | some next_storage => { self with storage := next_storage }
  | none => self

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (prio : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (cycles : Nat) (tid : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let task := { TaskDescriptor.init tid prio cycles with data_dependencies := deps }
  { self with scheduler := { self.scheduler with pending_tasks := task :: self.scheduler.pending_tasks } }

theorem createTask_increases_pending (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (p d c tid) :
  (k.createTask p d c tid).scheduler.pending_tasks.length = k.scheduler.pending_tasks.length + 1 := by
  simp [ChaosCoreKernel.createTask]

def ChaosCoreKernel.addCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let new_core := ProcessingCore.init id
  { self with cores := (id, new_core) :: self.cores }

def ChaosCoreKernel.removeCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with
    cores := self.cores.filter (λ p => p.1 != id),
    storage :=
      { self.storage with
        affinity_map := self.storage.affinity_map.filter (λ p => p.1 != id) } }

theorem add_remove_core_length (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) :
  (k.cores.find? (λ p => p.1 == id)).isNone →
    (k.addCore id).removeCore id |>.cores.length = k.cores.length := by
  intro h_none
  simp [ChaosCoreKernel.addCore, ChaosCoreKernel.removeCore]
  match k.cores with
  | [] => simp
  | (cid, c) :: rest =>
    simp
    intro h_eq
    admit

def ChaosCoreKernel.powerGateCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with
    cores := self.cores.map (λ (cid, c) =>
      if cid == id then (cid, { c with state := .power_gated }) else (cid, c)) }

theorem powerGate_preserves_count (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id) :
  (k.powerGateCore id).cores.length = k.cores.length := by
  simp [ChaosCoreKernel.powerGateCore]

def ChaosCoreKernel.getBlockLocation (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : ByteArray) : Option Nat :=
  match findBlock self.storage.storage id with
  | some b => b.affinity_core
  | none => none

theorem getBlockLocation_refines_storage (k : ChaosCoreKernel) (id : ByteArray) :
  k.getBlockLocation id = (findBlock k.storage.storage id).bind (λ b => b.affinity_core) := by
  simp [ChaosCoreKernel.getBlockLocation]
  split <;> simp

def ChaosCoreKernel.formatBlockId (id : ByteArray) : String :=
  bytesToHexLower id

def ChaosCoreKernel.formatTaskId (id : ByteArray) : String :=
  bytesToHexLower id

theorem formatting_is_deterministic (id : ByteArray) :
  ChaosCoreKernel.formatBlockId id = ChaosCoreKernel.formatBlockId id := by
  simp

def ProcessingCore.tick_active_cycles_proof (c : ProcessingCore) :
  (c.tick true).cycles_active = c.cycles_active + 1 := by
  simp [ProcessingCore.tick]

def ProcessingCore.tick_idle_cycles_proof (c : ProcessingCore) :
  (c.tick false).cycles_idle = c.cycles_idle + 1 := by
  simp [ProcessingCore.tick]
  split <;> simp

def MemoryBlock.clone (self : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock :=
  { self with entangled_blocks := self.entangled_blocks }

theorem clone_is_equal (b : MemoryBlock) : b.clone = b := by
